The timeout is longer than the interval..es: El timeout es mayor que el intervalo. Usa un timeout menor que el intervalo.
The timeout is longer than the interval..pt-BR: O timeout é maior que o intervalo. Use um timeout menor que o intervalo.
The timeout is longer than the interval..fr: Le timeout est plus long que l'intervalle. Utilisez un timeout plus court que l'intervalle.
The timeout is longer than the interval..de: Der Timeout ist länger als das Intervall. Verwenden Sie einen Timeout, der kürzer als das Intervall ist.
The timeout is longer than the interval..id: Timeout lebih panjang dari interval. Gunakan timeout yang lebih pendek dari interval.
The timeout is longer than the interval..it: Il timeout è più lungo dell'intervallo. Usa un timeout più breve dell'intervallo.
The timeout is longer than the interval..tr: Zaman aşımı aralıktan uzun. Aralıktan kısa bir zaman aşımı kullanın.
The timeout is longer than the interval..vi: Timeout dài hơn khoảng thời gian. Hãy dùng timeout ngắn hơn khoảng thời gian.
The timeout is longer than the interval..ru: Таймаут длиннее интервала. Используйте таймаут короче интервала.
The timeout is longer than the interval..pl: Timeout jest dłuższy niż interwał. Użyj timeoutu krótszego niż interwał.
The timeout is longer than the interval..hi: टाइमआउट इंटरवल से लंबा है। इंटरवल से छोटा टाइमआउट रखें।

With no notification method, the scripts.es: Sin método de notificación, los scripts solo escriben en el log del router.
With no notification method, the scripts.pt-BR: Sem método de notificação, os scripts só escrevem no log do roteador.
With no notification method, the scripts.fr: Sans mode de notification, les scripts écrivent seulement dans le journal du routeur.
With no notification method, the scripts.de: Ohne Benachrichtigungsweg schreiben die Skripte nur ins Log des Routers.
With no notification method, the scripts.id: Tanpa metode notifikasi, skrip hanya menulis ke log router.
With no notification method, the scripts.it: Senza un metodo di notifica, gli script scrivono solo nel log del router.
With no notification method, the scripts.tr: Bildirim yöntemi yoksa betikler yalnızca yönlendiricinin günlüğüne yazar.
With no notification method, the scripts.vi: Khi không có cách thông báo, các script chỉ ghi vào log của router.
With no notification method, the scripts.ru: Без способа уведомления скрипты только пишут в лог роутера.
With no notification method, the scripts.pl: Bez sposobu powiadamiania skrypty tylko zapisują wpisy w logu routera.
With no notification method, the scripts.hi: सूचना का कोई तरीका न होने पर स्क्रिप्ट सिर्फ़ राउटर के लॉग में लिखती हैं।

If a watched host is your internet gatew.es: Si un host vigilado es tu puerta de enlace a internet, el mensaje de caída no puede salir mientras el enlace esté caído. El mensaje de recuperación se envía cuando vuelve.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.pt-BR: Se um host monitorado for o gateway da sua internet, a mensagem de queda não consegue sair enquanto o link estiver fora. A mensagem de retorno é enviada quando ele volta.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.fr: Si un hôte surveillé est votre passerelle internet, le message de panne ne peut pas partir tant que le lien est coupé. Le message de retour est envoyé quand il revient.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.de: Ist ein überwachter Host Ihr Internet-Gateway, kann die Down-Meldung nicht hinaus, solange die Verbindung ausgefallen ist. Die Up-Meldung wird gesendet, sobald sie zurück ist.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.id: Jika host yang dipantau adalah gateway internet Anda, pesan DOWN tidak bisa keluar selama link mati. Pesan UP dikirim saat link kembali.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.it: Se un host controllato è il tuo gateway internet, il messaggio DOWN non può partire finché il collegamento è giù. Il messaggio UP viene inviato quando torna.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.tr: İzlenen bir ana bilgisayar internet ağ geçidinizse, bağlantı kopukken DOWN mesajı çıkamaz. UP mesajı bağlantı döndüğünde gönderilir.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.vi: Nếu host được giám sát là gateway internet của bạn, tin DOWN không thể gửi đi khi đường truyền đang hỏng. Tin UP được gửi khi đường truyền trở lại.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.ru: Если наблюдаемый хост — ваш интернет-шлюз, сообщение DOWN не уйдёт, пока канал не работает. Сообщение UP отправляется, когда он возвращается.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.pl: Jeśli monitorowany host to Twoja brama internetowa, wiadomość DOWN nie wyjdzie, dopóki łącze nie działa. Wiadomość UP zostanie wysłana, gdy łącze wróci.
If a watched host is your internet gatew.hi: अगर निगरानी वाला होस्ट आपका इंटरनेट गेटवे है, तो लिंक डाउन रहते DOWN संदेश बाहर नहीं जा सकता। लिंक लौटने पर UP संदेश भेजा जाता है।

The bot token is stored in plain text in.es: El token del bot se guarda en texto plano en la configuración del router y en sus exportaciones. Usa un bot creado solo para alertas.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.pt-BR: O token do bot fica em texto puro na configuração do roteador e nas suas exportações. Use um bot criado só para alertas.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.fr: Le jeton du bot est stocké en clair dans la configuration du routeur et dans ses exports. Utilisez un bot créé uniquement pour les alertes.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.de: Das Bot-Token liegt im Klartext in der Router-Konfiguration und in deren Exporten. Verwenden Sie einen Bot, der nur für Meldungen angelegt wurde.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.id: Token bot tersimpan sebagai teks biasa di konfigurasi router dan hasil export-nya. Gunakan bot yang dibuat khusus untuk peringatan.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.it: Il token del bot è salvato in chiaro nella configurazione del router e nei suoi export. Usa un bot creato solo per gli avvisi.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.tr: Bot belirteci yönlendiricinin yapılandırmasında ve dışa aktarımlarında düz metin olarak saklanır. Yalnızca uyarılar için oluşturulmuş bir bot kullanın.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.vi: Token bot được lưu dưới dạng văn bản thuần trong cấu hình của router và trong các bản export. Hãy dùng một bot chỉ tạo cho cảnh báo.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.ru: Токен бота хранится открытым текстом в конфигурации роутера и в его экспортах. Используйте бота, созданного только для оповещений.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.pl: Token bota jest zapisany jawnym tekstem w konfiguracji routera i jej eksportach. Użyj bota utworzonego wyłącznie do alertów.
The bot token is stored in plain text in.hi: बॉट टोकन राउटर के कॉन्फ़िगरेशन और उसके एक्सपोर्ट में सादे टेक्स्ट में रखा जाता है। सिर्फ़ अलर्ट के लिए बनाया गया बॉट इस्तेमाल करें।

This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.es: Esto usa /tool e-mail, que ya debe estar configurado en el router.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.pt-BR: Isto usa /tool e-mail, que já precisa estar configurado no roteador.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.fr: Cela utilise /tool e-mail, qui doit déjà être configuré sur le routeur.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.de: Dies nutzt /tool e-mail, das auf dem Router bereits eingerichtet sein muss.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.id: Ini memakai /tool e-mail, yang harus sudah dikonfigurasi di router.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.it: Questo usa /tool e-mail, che deve essere già configurato sul router.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.tr: Bu, yönlendiricide önceden yapılandırılmış olması gereken /tool e-mail'i kullanır.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.vi: Cách này dùng /tool e-mail, vốn phải được cấu hình sẵn trên router.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.ru: Здесь используется /tool e-mail, который уже должен быть настроен на роутере.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.pl: Używa to /tool e-mail, które musi być już skonfigurowane na routerze.
This uses /tool e-mail, which must alrea.hi: यह /tool e-mail इस्तेमाल करता है, जो राउटर पर पहले से कॉन्फ़िगर होना चाहिए।

Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.es: Netwatch se ejecuta en el router, así que no puede avisar de que el propio router se quedó sin conexión.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.pt-BR: O Netwatch roda no roteador, então não consegue avisar que o próprio roteador ficou offline.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.fr: Netwatch s'exécute sur le routeur : il ne peut pas signaler que le routeur lui-même est hors ligne.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.de: Netwatch läuft auf dem Router und kann daher nicht melden, dass der Router selbst offline geht.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.id: Netwatch berjalan di router, jadi tidak bisa melaporkan bahwa router itu sendiri offline.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.it: Netwatch gira sul router, quindi non può segnalare che il router stesso è andato offline.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.tr: Netwatch yönlendiricide çalışır, bu yüzden yönlendiricinin kendisinin çevrimdışı olduğunu bildiremez.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.vi: Netwatch chạy trên router nên không thể báo rằng chính router đã offline.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.ru: Netwatch работает на роутере и не может сообщить, что сам роутер ушёл в офлайн.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.pl: Netwatch działa na routerze, więc nie zgłosi, że sam router przeszedł w tryb offline.
Netwatch runs on the router, so it canno.hi: Netwatch राउटर पर चलता है, इसलिए यह नहीं बता सकता कि राउटर खुद ऑफ़लाइन हो गया।
